name: s3outposts
description: Amazon S3 on Outposts provides access to S3 on Outposts operations.

subcommands.name: create-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an endpoint and associates it with the specified Outpost.

subcommands.name: list-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists endpoints associated with the specified Outpost.

subcommands.name: list-outposts-with-s3
subcommands.description: Lists the Outposts with S3 on Outposts capacity for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-shared-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists all endpoints associated with an Outpost that has been shared by Amazon Web Services Resource Access Manager (RAM).
